nodes.description: Constant MAX_UINT256 in SafeMath library used as the overflow bound for add().
Address of the current contract owner; written in Owned constructor and acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Hard cap of 1e27 tokens enforced in mintTokens.
ERC20 token symbol, set to AGRI in constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to AgriChain in constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Internal total supply; minted in constructor/mintTokens and decreased in burn.
Mapping of account balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, mintTokens and burn.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Global transfer switch consulted by the allowingTransfers modifier.
Mapping of privileged administrators consulted by the onlyAdmin modifier.
SafeMath.add: reverts on overflow using MAX_UINT256 - y bound.
SafeMath.sub: reverts when x < y, otherwise returns x - y.
SafeMath.mul: reverts on overflow using MAX_UINT256 / y bound.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Pending owner accepts ownership, transferring owner and clearing newOwner.
Token constructor: sets metadata, computes _totalSupply with unchecked multiplication and credits the owner.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Returns the stored balance of tokenOwner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' guarded by allowingTransfers.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender with no double-spend protection.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' guarded by allowingTransfers.
Returns remaining allowance of spender over tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval, an external callable hook.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts to reject ETH.
onlyAdmin function that performs an external call to an arbitrary tokenAddress.
onlyAdmin mint capped by MAX_SUPPLY using SafeMath.add.
onlyAdmin burn that reduces caller balance and _totalSupply.
onlyAdmin function enabling the transfer switch.
onlyAdmin function disabling the transfer switch.
onlyOwner function granting administrator privileges.
onlyOwner function revoking administrator privileges.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, admin checks, balances and external call targets.
Block timestamp; not referenced anywhere in this contract.
Transaction origin; not referenced anywhere in this contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied contract.
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an untrusted spender contract.
Unchecked multiplication initialTokenSupply * 10**uint(decimals) without SafeMath.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Spender/callee contract parameter of approveAndCall, used as external call target.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall.
Opaque calldata forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary token contract address parameter used as external call target.
Amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Mint amount parameter of mintTokens.
Burn amount parameter of burn.
Local alias of msg.sender in burn holding the burner address.
Address granted administrator rights in addAdministrator.
Address losing administrator rights in removeAdministrator.
Initial supply parameter of the AgriToken constructor, scaled by 10**decimals.
Candidate new owner parameter of transferOwnership.

edges.reason: Owned constructor reads msg.sender to initialize state.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
transferOwnership assigns the _newOwner parameter.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the authorization check.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor consumes the initialTokenSupply parameter.
Constructor performs the unchecked multiplication 10**decimals.
initialTokenSupply flows into the unchecked scaling multiplication.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor reads owner to credit balances[owner].
Constructor initializes balances[owner] with the total supply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub for the arithmetic computation.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
allowingTransfers modifier requires isAllowingTransfers on transfer.
tokens parameter drives balance adjustments in transfer.
to parameter indexes the recipient balance in transfer.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the new allowance in approve.
approve keys the allowance by msg.sender.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender].
allowingTransfers modifier requires isAllowingTransfers on transferFrom.
from parameter indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
to parameter indexes the recipient balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] to authorize the spend.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub on balances and allowances.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transferFrom decrements the nested allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender both as allowance key and as the 'from' argument.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval hook.
The untrusted spender contract can re-enter the token during receiveApproval.
Attacker-controlled spender address is used directly as the external call target.
tokenAddress parameter flows into the function body.
tokens parameter flows into the returned external transfer.
onlyAdmin reads administrators[msg.sender] for transferAnyERC20Token.
onlyAdmin modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on the caller.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Governance-supplied tokenAddress becomes the callee of the external call.
onlyAdmin reads administrators[msg.sender] for mintTokens.
onlyAdmin modifier gates mintTokens on the caller.
_value parameter drives the mint arithmetic.
mintTokens uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance updates.
mintTokens compares the new supply against MAX_SUPPLY.
mintTokens increases _totalSupply.
mintTokens credits balances[msg.sender].
onlyAdmin reads administrators[msg.sender] for burn.
onlyAdmin modifier gates burn on the caller.
_value parameter bounds the burn amount.
Local burner alias of msg.sender is used for balance mutation.
burn uses SafeMath.sub on balance and total supply.
burn decrements balances[burner].
burn decrements _totalSupply.
onlyAdmin reads administrators[msg.sender] for allowTransfers.
onlyAdmin modifier gates allowTransfers on the caller.
allowTransfers sets isAllowingTransfers to true.
onlyAdmin reads administrators[msg.sender] for disallowTransfers.
onlyAdmin modifier gates disallowTransfers on the caller.
disallowTransfers sets isAllowingTransfers to false.
onlyOwner reads owner for the addAdministrator guard.
onlyOwner modifier gates addAdministrator on the caller.
_admin parameter is written into the administrators mapping.
addAdministrator sets administrators[_admin] = true.
onlyOwner reads owner for the removeAdministrator guard.
onlyOwner modifier gates removeAdministrator on the caller.
_admin parameter is written into the administrators mapping.
removeAdministrator sets administrators[_admin] = false.
